\[
10x^2+\frac{260x}{\sqrt3}-1050
\]

The roots are
\[
x=\frac{-\frac{260}{\sqrt3}\pm \frac{440}{\sqrt3}}{20}
=\frac{-260\pm 440}{20\sqrt3}
\Rightarrow x=3\sqrt3,\quad x=-\frac{35\sqrt3}{3}.
\]
So the factorization is
\[
10\left(x-3\sqrt3\right)\left(x+\frac{35\sqrt3}{3}\right)
=\frac{10}{3}\left(x-3\sqrt3\right)\left(3x+35\sqrt3\right).
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{10}{3}\left(x-3\sqrt3\right)\left(3x+35\sqrt3\right)}
\]
